Review Text: Wow, where do I begin. Last week for Valentine’s Day I surprised my girlfriend with Miami Seaplane Island Adventure Tour to Islamorada and what an incredible experience! Tony, is a true gentleman and went above and beyond to help make this trip something my girlfriend will never forget (and myself). We’ve done a lot of cool stuff all over the world but this was one of the absolute coolest adventures we’ve been on. Starting off by seeing our neighborhood up close from an aerial view, then seeing the crystal blue waters on our way through the keys, to landing right up to the restaurant we had lunch at. Lunch was excellent, plenty of options and fresh seafood with live music! Tony’s flying was smooth and controlled, we felt safe and calm the entire time. We explored the island for a couple of hours before we got back on the plane to head home to Miami. Seeing our skyline again around sunset was also very special for us. Tony is sharp and I feel like I’ve made a new friend. I’m excited to plan another adventure very soon.

Review Text: Amazing trip to Key West with Miami Seaplane Tours.  The flight was fabulous and we saw lots of marine life on the way including sea turtles, sharks, manta ray, stingrays and whales.  Key West was busy but still felt relaxed and friendly.  Tony, our pilot, was so knowledgeable and informative that the whole day was a complete success.  Tony even circled so we could see some manatees which made our day!  I know the price is on the expensive side (especially for just a couple) but so worth it.  Don’t hesitate to book - you will have a once in a lifetime experience!
